name: AWS CloudSentry
description: Autonomous 3 AM Voice Incident Commander for AWS SREs. Triage CloudWatch alarms, diagnose stack traces with Bedrock, and safely execute ECS rollbacks with Voice 2FA.

tools.name: get_active_alarms
tools.description: Query AWS CloudWatch for active ALARM states across production services and clusters.

tools.name: fetch_error_logs
tools.description: Fetch trailing error logs and stack traces from AWS CloudWatch Logs for a failing service.

tools.name: diagnose_incident
tools.description: Use AWS Bedrock (Claude 3.5 Sonnet) to perform automated root-cause analysis on error logs.

tools.name: execute_rollback
tools.description: Roll back an Amazon ECS service task definition to a previous stable revision. Enforces Voice 2FA.

tools.name: post_slack_notification
tools.description: Post an incident remediation summary and audit trail to the team Slack channel.
